# Sudarshan AI Labs: site and service guide

Canonical domain: https://sudarshan-ai.com/
Business: Sudarshan AI Labs, the brand of NAVA-NETRA NEURAL SUDARSHAN LABS (OPC) PRIVATE LIMITED.
Location: C-469/C, Indira Nagar, Near HAL, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226016, India.
Service coverage: Lucknow and Uttar Pradesh, with remote work available across India where suitable.
Contact: sudarshanailabs@gmail.com · +91 70808 42220.
Currency: INR (₹). Starter offers are listed from ₹89; the live plans page is the source of truth for current pricing and inclusions.

## What the company does

Sudarshan AI Labs helps small and growing businesses improve discovery, build clearer digital experiences, convert enquiries and simplify customer follow-up. Work may include local search optimisation, Google Business Profile support, websites, landing pages, social media, advertising, lead generation, content, WhatsApp automation and practical AI solutions.

The company's Build, Automate, Transfer approach is designed to document agreed work and hand over assets and knowledge to the client. The exact scope is agreed before work begins. Outcomes depend on each business, its market, offer and follow-up capacity; no search position, lead volume or revenue result is guaranteed.
